messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to pin llmX-4b-v2 into catalog tomorrow 08:00 PT. Canary 10% for 30m, then promote if perf looks good. Need owners for smoke, canary watch, and rollback. @joel can you confirm capacity?

raj: I can own the smoke run. Will do the perf + answer-quality checks. Can someone drop the smoke checklist here?

sophia: I can review the canary routing config and watch traces. Please @mention me when deploy is scheduled.

maya: Smoke checklist (short):
```
1) run smoke_prompt_set.sh against staging slot
2) validate 95p latency <= 220ms
3) check top-5 prompt similarity/regression (failing >=3 prompts -> rollback)
4) sanity tokens-per-request and cost delta
```

raj: got it. I'll run (1) and (2), and post outputs. Where's the prompt set?

maya: prompt set is in repo: infra/ops/smoke_sets/llmX-4b-v2.json (use the small subset). Also run `scripts/compare_quality --baseline llmX-4b-v1` — that flags regressions.

sam: For rollback: alias swap is the safest. I can be on-call to execute alias swap and purge caches. Need someone to own registry staging->prod check (weights present + checksum).

joel: Capacity confirmed. We have 12 GPUs in the dedicated pool, should handle 10% canary at expected qps. We'll reserve 2 spare for burst.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy request created by maya for 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z (meta id: d-8342).

raj: Quick question — which quant profile are we using? 4-bit or 8-bit? That impacts latency checks.

maya: Using quant profile `q4_0_perf` for canary. If regression for quality appears, switch to `q8_balanced` in a rollback candidate.

sophia: One more: update the model-catalog entry with `pinned_version: llmX-4b-v2` and add notes about the fallback alias `llmX-4b-stable -> llmX-4b-v1`. I'll open a tiny PR now.

raj: PR LGTM when posted. I'll watch the canary and run smoke. Will post the smoke logs here (`/logs/smoke-llmX-4b-v2-2795018888.txt`).

sam: I'll be on standby for alias swap (rollback) and can run it within 5 minutes if needed. Share the exact command in the runbook.

maya: Runbook snippet: `catalogctl alias swap --from llmX-4b-v2 --to llmX-4b-v1 --dry-run=false --notify=#eng-ml` — only run after approval from @maya or @joel.

joel: I'll monitor infra metrics and give the green light at +15m if no anomalies.

maya: Thanks. Final ask — anyone else who needs to be looped in? If not, I'll hit deploy-bot approve at 14:45 PT and ping the on-call. :thumbsup:

sophia: No one else from my side. Thanks for the checklist.

raj: All set here.

maya: OK scheduling final approval at 14:45 PT, deploy at 15:00Z. I'll update the catalog PR with the deploy ID and expected rollback window.

deploy-bot: deploy d-8342 moved to APPROVED by maya at 2026-03-18T14:45:12Z.
